mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.1% signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle that reduces equity discount rates and boosts forward returns, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.0% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that triggers recession fears and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal a broad-based economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 900 and INDPRO < 100, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial contraction regimes (INDPRO < 100 for 3 months), supply chain disruptions reduce manufacturing output and corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of INDPRO < 100 periods, or Rank IC for INDPRO < 100 falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average signals robust aggregate demand that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of RSAFS above moving average periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signal labor market contraction that heightens recession risk and drives negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of UNRATE > 7.0% and PAYEMS decline periods, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.0%), a decline in housing permits (HOUST) signals housing sector weakness that reduces GDP growth momentum and causes negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of GDPC1 > 2.0% and HOUST decline periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
